_about: Object knowledge store (repeat levels: N = compartments, N+1 boards: a bottom, N-1 between, a top): real-world object categories as PART ROLES with dimension ranges [min, max, typical] in metres and the formulas that place every part. Written as data so new categories need no code. Sizes follow common ergonomic / furniture standards (seat height ~0.45 m, dining table ~0.75 m, desk ~0.74 m, bookcase depth 0.25-0.35 m, shelf thickness 0.02-0.03 m). Sources: general woodworking / furniture-design conventions (no text copied); licence: facts, none claimed.
